lines.zh: 云阶很滑，我的袍角扫过。
lines.en: The cloud steps are slick; my hem sweeps them.

lines.zh: 神殿的长廊我每天走三遍。
lines.en: I walk the temple hall three times a day.

lines.zh: 紫水晶在袋里叮当作响。
lines.en: Amethyst shards chime in my pouch.
After long walks in mist, my feet forget the ground.
Seven wares, and I carry them steady.
The eave bells count my steps for me.

lines.zh: 别踩那条云缝，会漏下去。
lines.en: Do not step on that cloud seam; you would fall through.
I skirt the altar; the wind is fierce there.
At the temple gate, it is time to close shop.

lines.zh: 同族在前，我踩着云影走。
lines.en: Kin walk ahead; I tread their cloud shadows.

lines.zh: 台阶数到九，我总忘第十。
lines.en: I count nine steps and always forget the tenth.
The wind has scattered my trade list.
I walk slowly, so the clouds stay calm.

lines.zh: 殿外的浮岛又漂远了一点。
lines.en: The floating isle outside has drifted a little.
The cloud beneath me rolls over.

lines.zh: 我数着今天能换几块紫水晶。
lines.en: I count how many shards today will bring.
The censer is cold. Who forgot the flame?

lines.zh: 七种交易，我记在袖子里。
lines.en: Seven trades, written inside my sleeve.
Thunder far off; the temple does not hide.
My brim is pulled down low.

lines.zh: 云海安静得能听见针落。
lines.en: The cloud sea is quiet enough to hear a pin.
A customer comes; I should stand straighter.
My sums are done, still two shards short.
The corner chime rings by itself.
I arranged my stall three times.

lines.zh: 这里的空气薄，说话费劲。
lines.en: The air is thin here; speaking takes effort.

lines.zh: 云影移过石板，像有人走过。
lines.en: A cloud shadow crosses the stone like a passerby.
I pat my pocket to be sure it is still there.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，是有货想换吗？
lines.en: You look up at me; is there a trade you want?

lines.zh: 紫水晶碎片，你带了几块？
lines.en: Amethyst shards: how many did you bring?

lines.zh: 别在殿里开箱子，我会记仇。
lines.en: Do not open chests in the hall; I will remember.

lines.zh: 你的手别碰那边的匣子。
lines.en: Keep your hands off that coffer.
You look like you took a wrong cloud.
Pick one of seven; do not be greedy.
You carry ash from below on you.
Do not stand so close to my stall.
Do not let your eyes wander; prices shift.

lines.zh: 你要是不换，就走云桥吧。
lines.en: If you will not trade, take the cloud bridge.

lines.zh: 我在估你袖子里有几块。
lines.en: I am guessing how many shards are in your sleeve.
What are you grinning at? No smiling above clouds?
My kin are all watching your pack.
You speak first; I dislike guessing.

lines.zh: 别把匣子当货摊，我会叫人的。
lines.en: Do not treat the chest as my stall; I will call the others.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正好压着我的影子。
lines.en: Where you stand, you cover my shadow.
You cut off my quotation.
Now my trade list is a mess again.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，价还算得清。
lines.en: My hands shake, but I can still do sums.
Not the face; customers look at the face.
It hurts, but I will bill you before striking.
My kin are watching; I must stay upright.
You have torn my robe.
That blow is worth three shards to me.
I step back; the price doubles.
No one above the clouds has hit me like that.
Amethyst light outshines any cloud.
Those few shards in your hand: I want them all.
One more shard and the price gets friendly.
Glittering things draw me the most.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的袋子，不是失礼。
lines.en: I stare at your pouch; it is not rudeness.
Shards for goods: that is the rule.
Yours is chipped at the edge. I will still take it.

lines.zh: 口袋沉一点，心就稳一点。
lines.en: A heavier pouch steadies my heart.
Do not jingle it; the shine makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我数到七，你还没掏出来。
lines.en: I counted to seven and you still have not paid.
Bump me and my trade list must be redone.
The cloud stair is narrow; we both should mind.
My robe is fraying; do not pull it.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压到我袍角了。
lines.en: Your heel is resting on my hem.
One step back, or the shards will spill.
No shoving inside the temple.
I have steadied myself; you steady too.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我袖子乱了。
lines.en: That knock has my sleeve all twisted.
Do not crowd; there is only one stall.
Your shoulder is far harder than cloud.

lines.zh: 云上成了对的，会一起守殿。
lines.en: Paired on the clouds, we guard the hall together.
She counts the left; I count the right.
Kin side by side make the wind gentler.
We trade goods, and we trade glances.
Two Stratlings, one stall.
Her shard string is longer than mine.

lines.zh: 雾散的时候，我们并肩走。
lines.en: When the mist lifts, we walk side by side.
Our nest lies behind the hall, where clouds are thick.
Do not intrude; we are settling accounts.
When old, we will watch the cloud bridge together.

lines.zh: 掉在云上的，我替你收着。
lines.en: What falls on the cloud, I keep for you.
This shard goes to the stall.
I bend slowly; do not rush me.
I pick it up: a chipped shard.
Whose goods fell? I will hold them.
A copper scrap on the ground. Worthless.
I tuck it away till the owner asks.

lines.zh: 云缝里掉了东西，够不着。
lines.en: Something fell in a cloud gap, out of reach.

lines.zh: 拾到的东西要记在账上。
lines.en: Found items must go in the ledger.

lines.zh: 这点重量，压不弯我的腰。
lines.en: This little weight will not bend my back.

lines.zh: 你开了那只箱子——我看见了。
lines.en: You opened that chest. I saw you.

lines.zh: 殿里的匣子不许外人碰。
lines.en: Coffers in the hall are not for outsiders.

lines.zh: 同族都听见了那声盖响。
lines.en: My kin all heard that lid close.

lines.zh: 交易到此为止，你犯忌了。
lines.en: Trading is over; you broke the rule.
My hand is already raised.
Open one more and see.

lines.zh: 惊灵不发火，除非你翻柜子。
lines.en: A Stratling stays calm unless you raid the chests.

lines.zh: 你把和气换成了一场横扫。
lines.en: You traded peace for a sweep.
There are rules above the clouds too.

lines.zh: 你的脸我刻在云板上了。
lines.en: I have carved your face into the cloud slab.
I count to three; you back off.
Stand still; do not slip behind me.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道送过来了。
lines.en: The wind brings your scent to me.

lines.zh: 你退到云桥那头也没用。
lines.en: Retreating to the bridge will not help.
My sweep can reach you.
My kin have half-circled you.
Do not play innocent; your pack is still open.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你手里的袋子。
lines.en: It is your pouch I am watching.
One more step back and I stop counting.
The wind is strong here; you cannot run fast.
A sweep, three and a half blocks. Just enough.
Back away; I would rather not hurt you.
That one was only half strength.
Wind off my sleeve; you can feel it.
Do not blame me; you opened the chest first.
I swept past your feet. That was a warning.

lines.zh: 步子站稳，再挨一下会倒。
lines.en: Plant your feet, or the next one drops you.
Do not tumble on the cloud steps.
My arm passes; the wind arrives first.

lines.zh: 下次换货，别带开锁的心。
lines.en: Next time you trade, leave the lock-picking behind.

lines.zh: 云聚成形，我就站在这里。
lines.en: Clouds gather into shape, and here I stand.
The Floating Cloud Temple opens today.
I am the seventh Stratling to arrive.
First a bell in the mist, then me.

lines.zh: 这块云板还认得我的脚。
lines.en: This cloud slab still knows my feet.

lines.zh: 货物带来，摊位自己长出来。
lines.en: The goods are here; the stall grows itself.
The temple needs someone to mind the stall.
I was squeezed out of a cloud seam.

lines.zh: 紫水晶的味道把我引来。
lines.en: The smell of amethyst drew me here.
Steady now; first check the wind.

lines.zh: 火在云上烧不久，可也够疼。
lines.en: Fire does not last on clouds, but it stings.

lines.zh: 从云阶摔下来，骨头还在。
lines.en: Falling off the cloud stair, and my bones held.

lines.zh: 云里没有河，你把我按进了什么？
lines.en: No rivers up here; what did you push me into?

lines.zh: 炸响震散了我脚边的云。
lines.en: The blast scattered the cloud at my feet.

lines.zh: 箭插在货摊上，比插在我身上糟。
lines.en: An arrow in my stall is worse than in me.

lines.zh: 药水味盖过了紫水晶的香。
lines.en: Potion stink overpowers the amethyst scent.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，只靠云气撑着。
lines.en: I do not eat; cloud vapor keeps me.

lines.zh: 雷打在殿顶，我的帽子焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the roof; my hat is singed.

lines.zh: 云在脚下散了，我什么也没抓住。
lines.en: The cloud dissolved; I caught nothing.
